ir.name: weighted_advantage_logsigmoid_weighted_sum_sqrt_norm_loss_v2
ir.intuition: Removed margin scaling and tanh clipping to avoid similarity with other candidates; introduced sqrt normalization of advantage_gap norm to reduce sensitivity to large gradients, ensuring numeric stability. Used weighted sum loss with logsigmoid for stable pairwise preference modeling, keeping the weighted sum but changing normalization to sqrt and removing margin and clipping to increase novelty and preserve expressiveness.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
norm_per_sample = norm(advantage_gap)
norm = maximum(sqrt(mean(norm_per_sample)), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
loss = -logsigmoid(x_raw)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
loss_sum = sum(loss_weighted) / maximum(sum(weight), epsilon)
return loss_sum
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm_mean = ops.mean(norm_per_sample)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.sqrt(norm_mean), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x_raw))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_sum
